_comment: Kiro IDE 1.0 hook config. Drop into .kiro/hooks/<name>.json - one file per hook set. Root version is the STRING "v1", not the integer 1. Triggers (10): SessionStart, Stop, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PreTaskExec, PostTaskExec, UserPromptSubmit, PostFileCreate, PostFileSave, PostFileDelete. The 0.x 'Manual' trigger was retired - manual invocation is now a steering file. Actions are action.type 'command' or 'agent'. Reference: https://kiro.dev/docs/hooks/
